sources.name: NL Income Tax Act, 2000, section 21.1 — Low income reduction
NL Regulation 18/26 — Low Income Tax Reduction Regulations for the 2025 and 2026 Taxation Years
NL Department of Finance — Low Income Tax Reduction

notes: NL 2026 BPA is $13,094 per official NL Department of Finance (indexed from $11,067 in 2025). The $15,000 figure takes effect in 2027, not 2026.

Low-Income Tax Reduction per Income Tax Act, 2000 s.21.1 and Reg 18/26: Amount A = $842 (21.1(2.1)(a)), Amount B = $563 (21.1(2.1)(b), qualified relation / 9(1)(b) only), clawback = 16%. Non-refundable (cannot exceed NL tax payable).

Thresholds are indexed annually under s.6.1(2) and NLR 121/07 (CPI formula). Base statutory amounts: $18,547 individual (21.1(2)(b)), $31,362 family (21.1(2)(c)). 2025 indexed thresholds derived from NL Department of Finance published elimination points: individual $23,928, family $40,460. 2026 indexing factor = 1.1% (CRA T4032-NL, KPMG 2026). 2026 indexed thresholds: individual $24,191 ($23,928 × 1.011), family $40,905 ($40,460 × 1.011). Confirmed by EY 2026 (individual clawback at $24,191, elimination at $29,454).

Calculator models a single employee. Qualified relation / eligible dependant status and adjusted income may be passed via TaxCalculationInput.hasQualifiedRelation, .claimsEligibleDependant, and .adjustedIncome. An eligible dependant's income is NOT included in adjusted income per s.21.1(1)(a).
